g.text: 0 Verify: the copy against its manifest → VERIFICATION: PASS,
the version named
1 Account and cluster: a system pool, work pools under the
cloud's autoscaler.
Gate: the autoscaler scales a work pool up and down on its own
2 Identity: namespace, service account, the read-only role.
Gate: kubectl auth can-i answers exactly the table
3 Watch: the governor in watch mode.
Gate: an audit with decisions and no write, one full day of the
service's own load
4 Feed and line: the response-time feed and the written line.
Gate: the feed's age under 15 s; the line signed off by the owner
5 Paired run: native against native with Omni-Compass on top.
Gate: the receipt read row by row, every LOSS explained or fixed
and rerun
6 Govern: the role granted, the OFF switch and the watchdog
wired.
Gate: the OFF switch drilled, every setting back within 60 s
7 Day two: upgrades, rollbacks, audits, alarms, the fleet; the
drill every quarter
